comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Ancient Iridescent Glassware

Further Research Quest name: Further Research on Ancient Glass
Skill requirement: r8 Search, r10 Archaeology, ITA(Italian)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Ruins of Pompeii discovery (from "Buried ruins of Rome" quest) + Glass Jewellery discovery (from "Old accessories map")
Required Sophia rank: 3
Sophia cost: 250 points
